findings.title: Single-trial estimate still described as pooled
findings.page_quote: Conclusion changed: a pooled estimate is now served where none was served before: a new claim, not a continuation.

evidence.quote: Single included trial that reported this outcome — the estimate is that trial's own effect; no random-effects pooling (tau^2, HKSJ and prediction interval are not applicable at k=1).

findings.why: The change notice calls the currently served estimate pooled, whereas the review explicitly identifies it as a single trial's reported effect. The round-one wording issue remains in this tab.
findings.fix: Preserve the signed notice bytes and add an adjacent clarification that the served estimate is single-trial, not pooled.

findings.title: Claim-check coverage asserted despite zero result claims checked
findings.page_quote: The claim check (reproduction.claim_check) compares the page's statements about the primary result with this object;
findings.why: The wording implies that the displayed primary-result claim was checked. The recorded check reports zero claims checked and zero outcome-result coverage.
findings.fix: Render the recorded coverage counts and state that no primary outcome-result claim was checked at this build.

findings.title: Strand checks presented as checking the primary claim object
findings.page_quote: The claim check (reproduction.claim_check) compares the page's statements about the primary result with this object;
findings.why: The recorded result checks cover four strand pools and zero outcome results. The text instead attributes checking to the displayed primary outcome claim object.
findings.fix: Describe the recorded strand-pool coverage explicitly and avoid asserting that the primary outcome claim object was checked.
